description: Maps system entity types to canonical gold standard types. Derived from NER evaluation confusion matrix analysis. System extracts correct entities but uses more specific subtypes.
note: Keys are system entity types and are lowercase with underscores, matching analysis/entity_types.json. Values are the gold standard's own labels and still use hyphens, because evaluation/ner/gold_standard.json has not been regenerated; this table is the boundary between the two vocabularies. When that file is regenerated under the canonical vocabulary, the values become underscored and the hyphen-only entries here disappear.
